title: TradeInsight Adaptive Provider Integration
documentationIdentityRule: The current package/build/QA identity is owned by release_identity.json, this release contract, VERSION.txt/app bootstrap and the last-loaded v18.9.0 release identity overlay. legacyPlanRule: Historical certification_plan.json and ci_pipeline_plan.json remain conserved legacy registries. Current execution authority is the three canonical GitHub workflows plus this release contract and run_full_certification.sh.
g0Diagnosis: DE.PULSE already had canonical provider routing, freshness, cache, telemetry, history, Research, SEC, Opportunity Radar and symbol-validation owners. v18.9 therefore integrates TradeInsight only through those owners: adjusted daily OHLCV as fallback/backfill, bounded multi-symbol history as admission-controlled client-side fan-out over /ohlc, and Congressional Trading Intelligence as SHADOW Research alternative evidence after direct SEC refresh.
schemaGateRule: TradeInsight SEC Form 4 enrichment, top movers and ticker/company search remain non-executable until exact production REST endpoint/output contracts are independently verified. Direct SEC/EDGAR remains authoritative for Form 4; MCP tool names must never be converted into guessed REST paths.
qualificationRule: The release-candidate identity promotion is source-changing and must earn fresh exact-head Fast and full Qualified evidence, including backend/race/randomized, renderer, Chrome and WebKit, before merge. No source change is permitted after Qualified unless a classified real defect requires fresh qualification.
releaseRule: One v18.9.0-development branch, one PR #62, exact-head Fast + Qualified, exact-head merge, then the single canonical G11-G16 release workflow. No retry/certification/promotion branch and no duplicate release workflow.
